metadata.title: Next Auth Admin
metadata.description: Standalone Next.js scaffold with i18n and theme

home.title: Welcome
home.subtitle: Sign in to open the dashboard, or create a new account.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: You are signed in. Session is backed by Better Auth cookies and Postgres.

profile.title: Profile
profile.avatarSectionDescription: Upload a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image up to 5 MB. Removing a custom photo restores your OAuth photo when available.
profile.passwordSectionDescription: Change your password or set one if you signed in with Google or GitHub.
profile.name: Name

validation.nameMin: Name must be at least 2 characters
validation.nameMax: Name must be at most 120 characters

password.oauthSetPasswordHint: You signed in with a social account. Set a password to also sign in with email.

errors.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters
errors.passwordMax: Password must be at most 128 characters

avatar.invalidType: Use a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image.
avatar.tooLarge: Image must be 5 MB or smaller.

dangerZone.title: Danger zone
dangerZone.subtitle: Irreversible actions for your account.
dangerZone.description: Permanently delete your account and all associated data. This cannot be undone.

consequences.profile: Your profile, name, and photo will be removed.
consequences.sessions: All active sessions will be signed out.
consequences.connectedAccounts: Google and GitHub connections will be removed.

dangerZone.dialogDescription: This action is permanent. Type your email to confirm.
dangerZone.emailConfirmationHint: Enter your account email exactly as shown above.
dangerZone.oauthReauthHint: You signed in with Google or GitHub. Email confirmation is required. If deletion fails, sign out and sign in again, then retry.
dangerZone.deleteError: Could not delete account. Please try again.
dangerZone.adminCannotDelete: Administrator accounts cannot be self-deleted. Ask another admin to remove this account if needed.

errors.emailMismatch: Email does not match your account.
errors.freshSessionRequired: Please sign out and sign in again, then retry deleting your account.

common.unknownError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

validation.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters
validation.passwordMax: Password must be at most 128 characters
validation.nameMin: Name must be at least 2 characters

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we will send a reset link if an account exists.
forgotPassword.success: If an account exists, we sent a reset link.
forgotPassword.submittedHint: Check your inbox and spam folder for the reset email.

resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
resetPassword.success: Password updated. You can sign in now.
resetPassword.missingToken: This reset link is incomplete. Request a new one.
resetPassword.invalidToken: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.

register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: Register with email and password. We will send a verification link.
register.oauthAccountExists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in with Google or GitHub. You can add a password in profile after signing in.
register.alreadyRegistered: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.

verifyEmail.title: Verify email
verifyEmail.success: Email verified. You can open the dashboard.
verifyEmail.invalidToken: This verification link is invalid or has expired.
verifyEmail.missingToken: Verification details are missing. Request a new email.

verifyEmailPending.title: Verify your email
verifyEmailPending.description: Check your inbox and click the verification link. If you did not receive it, resend the email below.
verifyEmailPending.resendSuccess: If an account exists and still needs verification, we sent a new email.
